steps.text:
Fixed the styled-components regression in [TablePagination.js](/testbed/packages/material-ui/src/TablePagination/TablePagination.js:122).

`TablePaginationMenuItem` now supplies an empty style object (`({})`) instead of invoking the styled resolver with no argument. This avoids the styled-components `undefined[0]` failure while retaining overrides and `sx` handling.

Validation: ESLint and `git diff --check` pass. The legacy unit suite cannot initialize under Node 22 because its jsdom setup overwrites a read-only `navigator` global.
